principle: The human is root. Voices are instruments, not principals. The robot is an executor, never an authority source.

F2.name: nous girl
F2.authority: source of human intent; does not sign
F2.use: root questions, human intent, and the source timbre for robot voice output

M2.name: hermes-agent
M2.use: narration, build logs, and agent speech

ROBOT.name: asimov-robot
ROBOT.authority: executor only; never an authority root
ROBOT.use: Asimov face tablet, speaker output, and robot face-state videos

compute_layers.human-intent: F2 / nous girl — HUMAN://ROOT intent, local tiny-voca CPU
compute_layers.agent-runtime: M2 / hermes-agent — agent execution, local tiny-voca CPU
compute_layers.robot-body: ROBOT / asimov-robot — F2 source resampled for Menlo Asimov speaker

note: Alias resolution is case-insensitive and normalizes '-' and '_' to spaces. Identity does not transfer authority.
